title: DTF Printing in Dubai: Fast, Reliable & Custom
excerpt: Why in-house DTF beats outsourcing when you need custom tees within hours — cost, wash tests & when to choose it over screen print.
body: Most suppliers struggle with tight deadlines because they outsource printing. Allegiant Attire runs an in-house DTF facility, which means your transfer is printed, powdered, cured and pressed under one roof â often the same day.

DTF (Direct-to-Film) carries full-color artwork, gradients and fine text onto cotton, poly and blends with no weeding and no minimum color charges. Wash tests at 40Â°C show strong adhesion past 30 cycles when cured correctly.

Rule of thumb: under 100 pcs or multi-color art with a deadline under 5 days â choose DTF. Above 200 pcs with 1â2 colors â screen printing wins on unit cost. Our team quotes both so you can compare line by line.

title: How to Select the Perfect Customized Hoodie
excerpt: GSM, fleece types, fit blocks & print zones — the checklist our merchandisers use before approving any hoodie run.
body: Start with purpose: staff hoodies want durability (350â400 GSM brushed fleece), merch drops want hand-feel (loopback French terry, garment-washed).
Check the fit block: measure a hoodie you love â chest, body length, sleeve â and match it to our size set before sampling. A size M varies 4 cm between factories.
Design for the zone: chest prints live in a 30Ã35 cm window; sleeve and hood prints cost extra setups. Keep fine text above 8 pt for embroidery legibility.

title: How to Design Custom Hoodies for Business or Event
excerpt: From audience to delivery day: graphics, placement, sizing curves & budgeting for 50–5,000 pcs.
body: Define audience first: staff want subtle left-chest marks; event crowds want big back prints they will actually wear again.
Plan the size curve with real headcounts â a typical UAE corporate curve is 5/20/40/25/10 across Sâ2XL. Order 3% extra for exchanges.
Budget smart: blank + print + label + bag + delivery. DTF adds flat per-print cost; embroidery scales with stitch count. We itemize all five.

title: Choosing a Bulk T-Shirt Printer in the UAE
excerpt: Methods, fabric truths, portfolio checks & red flags — how procurement teams vet a garment partner.
body: Check the methods they actually own: a supplier with in-house screen, DTF and embroidery can recommend honestly instead of selling the one machine they have.
Review product quality in hand: ask for a wash-tested sample with your artwork, not a stock photo. Check collar ribbing recovery and print hand-feel.
Verify capacity: 5,000 pcs in 10 days needs multiple carousels and cutting tables. Ask for floor photos and a production plan with milestones.
